notes.title: Deep Rock Galactic - Open Alpha Weekend!
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OVRP1Lc.jpg[/img]

Hey Guardians, would you like to try Deep Rock Galactic?

We are running an Open Alpha Weekend to stress-test and get feedback from aspiring miners!

[b]Check out the trailer:[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GBvTp7i-Cmo
[b]To get a key, you will need to sign up at:[/b]
https://www.deeprockgalactic.com/#openalpha-section

[b]Summary:[/b]
- Open Alpha: November 9th - 12th
- Sign-up Deadline: November 6th at 11:59 PM (CEST) 
- Keys Sent Out: November 9th at 01:00 PM (CEST) 
- Platform for Open Alpha: Steam (PC)
- Sign up: https://www.deeprockgalactic.com/#openalpha-section
- It's free!

[b]Note:[/b]
Please check your email's spam folder. We have experience that some of the emails we have sent out, are going directly to some of our receiver's spam folder.

Happy Mining!

notes.title: The Last Stand is out, and the Holiday Sale has begun!
notes.content:
Hey everyone. A bit late but if you missed it, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/237090/]The Last Stand[/url], the 4th "Season Pass" DLC was launched a couple of days ago!

In the DLC you'll get four brand new maps including the chance to revisit the classic map Arc from Sanctum.. Of course, you'll have new weapons as well, such as the high-tech Smatterband, an industrial weapon that fires sticky bombs that erupt into 10 smaller explosions each, and you'll get to unlock 8 new perks! It's one high voltage package!

Oh, did we say it's on discount together with [b]ALL[/b] our other products in the ongoing Holiday sale?
[list][*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/91600/]Sanctum[/url] ( ~cheeseburger )
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/210770/]Sanctum 2[/url] ( ~a mad mans bargain )
[*][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/235250/]Super Sanctum TD[/url] ( ~free? )[/list]
Check em all out if you haven't already, and if you like what we do, tell your friends to do so as well :)

[b]Best
Coffee Stain Studios Crew[/b]
